name: my-ui-kit-monorepo
description: Accessible, composable React UI kit + PWA reference app

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit && npm run dev -w bank
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit && npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit-elements && npm run build -w bank && npm run build -w demo
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w demo && npm run test:e2e -w bank
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build:lib && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm test -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit-elements && npm run test:governance && npm run build && npm run check:package && npm run size
scripts.release: npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit && npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit-elements && changeset publish
scripts.dev:clinic: npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit && npm run dev -w demo
